fusions.name: Unhurried Aim
fusions.desc: After a 1.5-second cast, looses a shot at the first enemy in line for 32 damage. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Flushed Rise
fusions.desc: A burst of wingbeats deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles. Your movement speed rises 25% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Feeding Call
fusions.desc: A call that pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Settled Feathers
fusions.desc: The moment your health is full, your next strike gains 15% critical chance. Once every 10 seconds.
